triples.evidence: critic_img.py (brief-aware judge on gemini-3.8-flash: brief match, anachronisms, text, real-person likeness, defects, tileable, beauty, usable_as; about $0.001 per image)
Tools: shroud/art/tools/genimage.py (prompts.json with id, aspect, prompt, use; writes PNG plus a JSON log with tokens and seconds)
Why: the first attempt lost time on the regional endpoint and on the rate limit; every thread that wants pictures starts from this.
Two quick calls succeed, the third gets HTTP 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: pace one call a minute, or retry after 60 to 70 s
How to apply: mark every generated image a stand-in (Suspected, no real faces, no text), judge it against its brief, keep model names off shared pages.
Generated PNGs count as images for the C2PA stamping on /mnt/project-files: hand them over in a tar with sha256, extract outside the mount.
